title: What is Everyone Pay?
summary: This document explains “Everyone Pay” transfer options: Standard transfers complete within 12 hours and have no instant fee; Instant transfers deliver right away with a $0.75 fee. It also notes Standard fits the 12-hour processing window and advises when to choose each option.
